scope: 260 個原創雙語學習工序，為 520 步教材前半。以文件、剖面圖、示意資料及可選的自備試算表進行比對；網站並未因此具備每一工序的物理求解器。數目代表教學拆分，不是單一晶圓廠的通用製造配方。
scopeEn: 260 original bilingual learning operations forming the first half of a 520-step curriculum. Use documents, cross-sections, illustrative data and optional external worksheets for comparison; this does not imply the website has a physical solver for every operation. The count represents educational subdivision, not a universal foundry recipe.
sequenceNote: prerequisiteIds 表示學習進度。量產路由需另依選定材料、元件、設備與經驗證程序建立；製程回圈及互斥分支不能直接按模組序號串成生產指令。
sequenceNoteEn: Prerequisites express learning progression. A manufacturing route must separately follow selected materials, devices, tools and qualified procedures; process loops and mutually exclusive branches cannot be concatenated by module number into production instructions.
estimateNote: estimatedMinutes 為單一閱讀/推演任務的規劃值，不是設備加工時間或保證完成時間。
estimateNoteEn: Estimated minutes are planning estimates for reading or analysis, not equipment cycle times or guaranteed completion times.

materialContext.usage: 使用者提供內容僅供主題及術語對照；未複製課堂圖片、配方或長段文字。

stages.title: 製程整合與來料品質
stages.description: 建立能連結材料、座標、量測與元件路線的來料證據。26 個操作包含剖面建模與真實量測方法的判讀。
stages.descriptionEn: Build incoming evidence connecting material, coordinates, metrology and device routes. The 26 operations combine cross-section modeling with interpretation of real measurement methods.
stages.route: 教育模組；替代技術依步驟明示為分支，不代表同一片晶圓必須全部依序加工。
stages.routeEn: Educational module; alternatives are labeled as branches and are not mandatory sequential operations on one wafer.

steps.title: 建立 CMOS 剖面層序
steps.objective: 閘極與通道之間保留介電層，接觸孔只連接指定節點。
steps.objectiveEn: A dielectric separates gate and channel; contacts connect only their assigned nodes.
steps.instruction: 依示意模型，以自行準備或從參考來源取得的圖、量測資料或試算表進行：將基板、隔離、井區、閘極與接觸層拖入剖面，標出導電及絕緣區域。
steps.instructionEn: Use schematic models and diagrams, measurement data or worksheets you supply or obtain from referenced sources. Place substrate, isolation, wells, gate and contact layers in a cross-section; mark conducting and insulating regions.
steps.observation: 保存本步操作前後的對照證據。判讀重點：閘極與通道之間保留介電層，接觸孔只連接指定節點。
steps.observationEn: Keep before-and-after evidence for this operation. Interpret it against this criterion: A dielectric separates gate and channel; contacts connect only their assigned nodes.
steps.failure: 若未符合判據，優先檢查：介電層遺漏或接觸節點放錯。這是待驗證的原因；回到相同測點或剖面比對，不能僅據異常外觀定因。
steps.failureEn: If the criterion is not met, investigate: Missing dielectric or misassigned contact nodes. This is a hypothesis; compare matching sites or cross-sections before assigning a cause.
steps.check: 閘極與通道之間保留介電層，接觸孔只連接指定節點。
steps.checkEn: A dielectric separates gate and channel; contacts connect only their assigned nodes.

knowledge.title: 本步的可檢核證據
knowledge.text: 閘極與通道之間保留介電層，接觸孔只連接指定節點。 對應操作：將基板、隔離、井區、閘極與接觸層拖入剖面，標出導電及絕緣區域。
knowledge.textEn: A dielectric separates gate and channel; contacts connect only their assigned nodes. Corresponding operation: Place substrate, isolation, wells, gate and contact layers in a cross-section; mark conducting and insulating regions.

knowledge.title: 機制與診斷邊界
knowledge.text: 量測數字只有在量測位置、參考面、單位與方法一致時才可比較；示範驗收界線由課程情境提供，不是通用產業規格。 本步特別排查：介電層遺漏或接觸節點放錯。
knowledge.textEn: Measurements are comparable only with consistent locations, reference planes, units and methods. Exercise acceptance limits are scenario inputs, not universal industry specifications. Specifically examine: Missing dielectric or misassigned contact nodes.

quiz.question: 哪一項證據最直接支持「建立 CMOS 剖面層序」這一步的完成？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports completion of "Build the CMOS cross-section stack"?
options: 直徑變化與局部缺口分開記錄，沒有只採單一方向。
粗糙度數值同時附掃描範圍與去背景方法。
閘極與通道之間保留介電層，接觸孔只連接指定節點。
optionsEn: Diameter variation is reported separately from the notch rather than from one direction alone.
Roughness is accompanied by scan area and background-removal method.
A dielectric separates gate and channel; contacts connect only their assigned nodes.
quiz.explanation: 本步驗收的是：閘極與通道之間保留介電層，接觸孔只連接指定節點。 其他選項雖可能是有效工程檢查，但不能取代本步證據。
quiz.explanationEn: This operation is accepted against: A dielectric separates gate and channel; contacts connect only their assigned nodes. The other options may be valid engineering checks but do not replace this evidence.

steps.title: 分配光罩圖層
steps.objective: 每一圖層的用途、極性與參考原點可追溯。
steps.objectiveEn: Every layer has a traceable purpose, tone and reference origin.
steps.instruction: 依示意模型，以自行準備或從參考來源取得的圖、量測資料或試算表進行：把主動區、井區、閘極及接觸的平面圖分開，再疊回同一座標。

steps.failureEn: If the criterion is not met, investigate: Mixed layer tones, origins or revisions. This is a hypothesis; compare matching sites or cross-sections before assigning a cause.

steps.title: 辨識製程路線分支
steps.objective: 不同路線的隔離高度與閘極包覆方式分別標示。
steps.objectiveEn: Isolation height and gate enclosure are labeled separately for each route.
steps.instruction: 依示意模型，以自行準備或從參考來源取得的圖、量測資料或試算表進行：並排平面 CMOS、FinFET 與奈米片剖面，圈出不可直接沿用的幾何。

steps.failureEn: If the criterion is not met, investigate: Planar dimensions carried into three-dimensional structures. This is a hypothesis; compare matching sites or cross-sections before assigning a cause.

steps.title: 核對基板種類
steps.objective: 埋氧層或磊晶層沒有被誤當成裸矽厚度。
steps.objectiveEn: Buried oxide and epitaxial layers are not mistaken for bulk silicon thickness.
steps.instruction: 依示意模型，以自行準備或從參考來源取得的圖、量測資料或試算表進行：比對塊材矽、磊晶矽與 SOI 的來料截面，選擇與教材路線相符者。

steps.failure: 若未符合判據，優先檢查：基板產品型號與截面對不上。這是待驗證的原因；回到相同測點或剖面比對，不能僅據異常外觀定因。
steps.failureEn: If the criterion is not met, investigate: Substrate product type mismatches the section. This is a hypothesis; compare matching sites or cross-sections before assigning a cause.
steps.check: 埋氧層或磊晶層沒有被誤當成裸矽厚度。

steps.title: 比對導電型態
steps.objective: 基板導電型態與井區反向接面的安排相符。
steps.objectiveEn: Substrate conductivity is consistent with the intended reverse-biased well junctions.
steps.instruction: 依示意模型，以自行準備或從參考來源取得的圖、量測資料或試算表進行：用來料證明及示意電性量測判斷 p 型或 n 型，與井區設計交叉核對。

steps.check: 基板導電型態與井區反向接面的安排相符。

steps.title: 定位主動區與隔離區

stages.route: 教育模組；替代技術依步驟明示為分支，不代表同一片晶圓必須全部依序加工。
stages.routeEn: Educational module; alternatives are labeled as branches and are not mandatory sequential operations on one wafer.

steps.title: 標示 n 井與 p 井
steps.objective: 井區型態與元件本體電位安排一致。
steps.objectiveEn: Well type is consistent with device-body biasing.
steps.instruction: 依示意模型，以自行準備或從參考來源取得的圖、量測資料或試算表進行：在 CMOS 截面把 PMOS 與 NMOS 所需井區配對，追蹤接面極性。
steps.instructionEn: Use schematic models and diagrams, measurement data or worksheets you supply or obtain from referenced sources. Match PMOS and NMOS devices to their wells in a CMOS section and track junction polarity.
steps.observation: 保存本步操作前後的對照證據。判讀重點：井區型態與元件本體電位安排一致。
steps.observationEn: Keep before-and-after evidence for this operation. Interpret it against this criterion: Well type is consistent with device-body biasing.
steps.failure: 若未符合判據，優先檢查：井區型態或本體偏壓極性錯誤。這是待驗證的原因；回到相同測點或剖面比對，不能僅據異常外觀定因。
steps.failureEn: If the criterion is not met, investigate: Wrong well type or body-bias polarity. This is a hypothesis; compare matching sites or cross-sections before assigning a cause.
steps.check: 井區型態與元件本體電位安排一致。
steps.checkEn: Well type is consistent with device-body biasing.

knowledge.title: 本步的可檢核證據
knowledge.text: 井區型態與元件本體電位安排一致。 對應操作：在 CMOS 截面把 PMOS 與 NMOS 所需井區配對，追蹤接面極性。
knowledge.textEn: Well type is consistent with device-body biasing. Corresponding operation: Match PMOS and NMOS devices to their wells in a CMOS section and track junction polarity.

knowledge.title: 機制與診斷邊界
knowledge.text: 植入面劑量、深度分布、化學濃度與活性載子濃度是不同量。退火可能修復損傷並活化摻雜，也會改變擴散剖面。 本步特別排查：井區型態或本體偏壓極性錯誤。
knowledge.textEn: Implanted areal dose, depth distribution, chemical concentration and active-carrier concentration are different quantities. Annealing can repair damage and activate dopants while also changing diffusion profiles. Specifically examine: Wrong well type or body-bias polarity.

quiz.question: 哪一項證據最直接支持「標示 n 井與 p 井」這一步的完成？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports completion of "Label n-wells and p-wells"?
options: 深度趨勢由分布判讀，沒有把能量當作劑量。
化學摻雜濃度不被直接當成活性載子濃度。
井區型態與元件本體電位安排一致。
optionsEn: Depth trends are interpreted from the distribution without confusing energy with dose.
Chemical dopant concentration is not treated as active-carrier concentration.
Well type is consistent with device-body biasing.
quiz.explanation: 本步驗收的是：井區型態與元件本體電位安排一致。 其他選項雖可能是有效工程檢查，但不能取代本步證據。
quiz.explanationEn: This operation is accepted against: Well type is consistent with device-body biasing. The other options may be valid engineering checks but do not replace this evidence.

steps.title: 配置深井隔離分支
steps.objective: 深井形成的隔離路徑可在剖面連續追蹤。
steps.objectiveEn: The isolation path created by the deep well can be followed continuously in the section.
steps.instruction: 依示意模型，以自行準備或從參考來源取得的圖、量測資料或試算表進行：在三重井示意加入深井，畫出隔離邊界及基板耦合路徑。
steps.instructionEn: Use schematic models and diagrams, measurement data or worksheets you supply or obtain from referenced sources. Add a deep well to a triple-well model and draw isolation boundaries and substrate-coupling paths.

steps.failureEn: If the criterion is not met, investigate: Deep-well boundaries fail to form continuous isolation. This is a hypothesis; compare matching sites or cross-sections before assigning a cause.
steps.check: 深井形成的隔離路徑可在剖面連續追蹤。
steps.checkEn: The isolation path created by the deep well can be followed continuously in the section.

steps.title: 建立井區植入遮罩
steps.objective: 未植入區有連續遮蔽，開口與井區對齊。
steps.objectiveEn: Protected regions have continuous masking and openings align with the well layout.

steps.instructionEn: Use schematic models and diagrams, measurement data or worksheets you supply or obtain from referenced sources. Convert well layouts into mask openings and inspect adjacent devices and overlap margins.

steps.check: 未植入區有連續遮蔽，開口與井區對齊。

steps.title: 核對遮罩阻擋能力
steps.objective: 遮罩下的尾端分布納入評估，不能只看平均射程。
steps.objectiveEn: The under-mask tail is evaluated rather than only mean projected range.
steps.instruction: 依示意模型，以自行準備或從參考來源取得的圖、量測資料或試算表進行：比較植入深度分布與遮罩等效阻擋厚度，觀察穿透尾端。
steps.instructionEn: Use schematic models and diagrams, measurement data or worksheets you supply or obtain from referenced sources. Compare implant-depth distributions with effective mask stopping thickness and inspect penetration tails.

steps.check: 遮罩下的尾端分布納入評估，不能只看平均射程。

stages.descriptionEn: Decompose nucleation, delivery, surface reactions, coverage, stress and film metrology; deposition families are purpose-dependent alternatives.

steps.title: 選擇沉積機制
steps.objective: 選型根據覆蓋需求與材料限制，不只看沉積速度。
steps.objectiveEn: Selection follows coverage and material constraints, not deposition speed alone.
steps.instruction: 依示意模型，以自行準備或從參考來源取得的圖、量測資料或試算表進行：對同一溝槽比較 PVD、CVD 與 ALD 成長示意，標示方向性與表面反應。
steps.instructionEn: Use schematic models and diagrams, measurement data or worksheets you supply or obtain from referenced sources. Compare PVD, CVD and ALD growth in the same trench and label directionality and surface reactions.
steps.observation: 保存本步操作前後的對照證據。判讀重點：選型根據覆蓋需求與材料限制，不只看沉積速度。
steps.observationEn: Keep before-and-after evidence for this operation. Interpret it against this criterion: Selection follows coverage and material constraints, not deposition speed alone.
steps.failure: 若未符合判據，優先檢查：沉積機制不符合覆蓋幾何。這是待驗證的原因；回到相同測點或剖面比對，不能僅據異常外觀定因。
steps.failureEn: If the criterion is not met, investigate: Deposition mechanism incompatible with coverage geometry. This is a hypothesis; compare matching sites or cross-sections before assigning a cause.
steps.check: 選型根據覆蓋需求與材料限制，不只看沉積速度。
steps.checkEn: Selection follows coverage and material constraints, not deposition speed alone.

knowledge.textEn: Selection follows coverage and material constraints, not deposition speed alone. Corresponding operation: Compare PVD, CVD and ALD growth in the same trench and label directionality and surface reactions.

knowledge.title: 機制與診斷邊界
knowledge.text: 名義膜厚不足以決定共形性、連續性或材料品質。ALD 的自限半反應可改善控制，但每循環成長量依材料及條件而變。 本步特別排查：沉積機制不符合覆蓋幾何。
knowledge.textEn: Nominal thickness does not determine conformality, continuity or material quality. Self-limiting ALD half-reactions improve control, but growth per cycle depends on material and conditions. Specifically examine: Deposition mechanism incompatible with coverage geometry.

quiz.question: 哪一項證據最直接支持「選擇沉積機制」這一步的完成？

optionsEn: Increasing nominal thickness is not sufficient evidence of film continuity.
Selection follows coverage and material constraints, not deposition speed alone.
Self-limiting saturation follows the curve rather than assuming one complete atomic layer per pulse.

steps.instructionEn: Use schematic models and diagrams, measurement data or worksheets you supply or obtain from referenced sources. Compare mask, stage and wafer coordinate axes and inspect inversion and reduction directions.

steps.check: 平面鏡像及座標轉換有一致定義。
steps.checkEn: Image inversion and coordinate transformations have consistent definitions.

knowledge.title: 機制與診斷邊界
knowledge.text: 解析度、焦深、劑量、套刻與隨機缺陷是不同的成像限制。校正平均偏差不能自動消除局部或隨機尾端缺陷。 本步特別排查：鏡像、倍率或座標方向混淆。
knowledge.textEn: Resolution, depth of focus, dose, overlay and stochastic defects impose different imaging limits. Correcting a mean bias does not automatically eliminate local or stochastic-tail defects. Specifically examine: Confused inversion, reduction or coordinate directions.
